mapper.select: SELECT * FROM yan_notification_outbox WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',locked_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3)
UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET status='PENDING',cursor_follower_id=#{cursorFollowerId},locked_until=NULL,next_retry_at=NOW(3),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET status='SUCCEEDED',locked_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET status='PENDING',retry_count=retry_count+1,next_retry_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND),locked_until=NULL,last_error=#{reason},update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET status='PENDING',locked_until=NULL,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND locked_until < NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT follower_id FROM yan_user_follow WHERE followee_id=#{authorId} AND follower_id > #{cursorFollowerId} ORDER BY follower_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM yan_user_follow WHERE followee_id=#{authorId}
